children: Clearpool is targeting a 1:1 migration from CPOOL to CLEAR in Q4 2026 following an approved governance vote. The planned swap replaces the CPOOL ticker with CLEAR at a rate of one CLEAR token for each CPOOL token.

For holders, the transition requires moving their token position to CLEAR rather than adjusting to a different conversion ratio. Exchanges will need to manage the change in listings and the migration of liquidity from the existing ticker to the new one. With token supply unchanged, the practical focus is on swap execution and liquidity transition, not a change in token economics driven by the migration.
The Clearpool community has approved expansion to the XRP Ledger and the 1:1 migration of CPOOL → CLEAR with 97.16% in favor.
Migration is targeted for Q4. More details on next steps to come 🙏

title: Clearpool: Targets 1:1 CPOOL-to-CLEAR Token Migration - Q4 2026
